user.title: Sources
user.description: Pick the existing P1 entities this integration builds on. The meter's own values (DSMR: *Belgium current average demand* and *Belgium maximum demand current month*; HomeWizard: *Average demand* / *Peak demand current month*) are the most accurate source. Without them the quarter is calculated from the import registers or the power sensor.

data.meter_average_entity: Average demand – HomeWizard 'Average demand', DSMR 'Current average demand' (OBIS 1.4.0)
data.meter_peak_entity: Peak demand current month – HomeWizard 'Peak demand current month', DSMR 'Maximum demand current month' (OBIS 1.6.0)
data.energy_entities: Energy import (kWh) – e.g. HomeWizard 'Energy import' or 'Energy import tariff 1' + 'tariff 2'

data_description.power_entity: Required. Drives the forecast and the fallback calculation. Negative values (injection) count as 0.
data_description.meter_average_entity: Recommended – the meter's own running quarter-hour average, exactly what the grid operator bills. Without it the integration estimates it from power/energy.
data_description.meter_peak_entity: Recommended – the meter's own monthly peak. Becomes the peak of record.
data_description.energy_entities: Fallback when the meter values are not available; several registers are summed.

data.warning_threshold_pct: Warning threshold (% of the target peak)

data_description.tariff_eur_per_kw_year: See your grid operator's invoice (Fluvius). Leave empty to hide the cost sensors.
data_description.warning_threshold_pct: 'Peak at risk' switches on when the predicted quarter exceeds this share of the target peak.
